pi2 = math.pi*2 sin = math.sin cos = math.cos function onTick() bilt = input.getNumber(1) depth = input.getNumber(2) dist = input.getNumber(3) vert = input.getNumber(4)
off = property.getNumber("Deck Height")*-1 tower = property.getNumber("Sail Position") factor = property.getNumber("Depth Scale")
altBow = property.getBool("Alternate Bow") altStern = property.getBool("Alternate Stern") sillyMode = property.getBool("Stan") end
function onDraw() w = screen.getWidth() h = screen.getHeight()
tilt = -bilt * pi2
floor = (sin((0.25 * pi2) + tilt) * dist) - depth
tOff = (-off * 0.8) + 3
taper1 = (-off * 0.5) + 1 taper2 = (-off * 1) + 3
gx = (w/2) gy = (h/2) + 2 - tilt * 12
x1 = (cos((0.02 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gx y1 = (sin((0.02 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gy
x2 = (cos((0.48 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gx y2 = (sin((0.48 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gy
cx1 = (cos((0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*off) + gx cy1 = (sin((0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*off) + gy
x3 = (cos((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*21) + cx1 y3 = (sin((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*21) + cy1
x4 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*25) + cx1 y4 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*25) + cy1
--
ex1 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + x1 ey1 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + y1
ex3 = (cos((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + x3 ey3 = (sin((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + y3
--
ax1 = (cos((0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + x4 ay1 = (sin((0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + y4
ax2 = (cos((-0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + ex1 ay2 = (sin((-0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + ey1
ax3 = (cos((0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + ex3 ay3 = (sin((0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + ey3
ax4 = (cos((-0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + x2 ay4 = (sin((-0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + y2
--
tbx1 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*tower) + x3 tby1 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*tower) + y3
tbx2 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*(tower+12)) + x3 tby2 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*(tower+12)) + y3
tx1 = (cos((-0.2 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tbx1 ty1 = (sin((-0.2 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tby1
tx2 = (cos((-0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tbx2 ty2 = (sin((-0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tby2
dy = y1 + depth * factor
by = y1 + (sin((0.25 * pi2) + tilt) * dist * factor)
--
tx = (cos(-0.4 * pi2)*2.5) + gx ty = (sin(-0.4 * pi2)*2.5) + gy - 0.5
screen.setColor(50,25,5,50)
screen.drawLine(x1,y1, x2,y2)
screen.drawLine(x3,y3, x4,y4)
if altBow then
screen.drawLine(x4,y4, ax1,ay1) screen.drawLine(ex1,ey1, ax2,ay2) screen.drawLine(ax2,ay2, ax1,ay1) screen.drawLine(x1,y1, ex1,ey1)
else
screen.drawLine(x1,y1, x4,y4)
end
if altStern then
screen.drawLine(x3,y3, ex3,ey3) screen.drawLine(ex3,ey3, ax3,ay3) screen.drawLine(x2,y2, ax4,ay4) screen.drawLine(ax3,ay3, ax4,ay4)
else
screen.drawLine(x2,y2, x3,y3)
end
screen.drawLine(tx1,ty1, tx2,ty2)
screen.drawLine(tbx1,tby1, tx1,ty1)
screen.drawLine(tbx2,tby2, tx2,ty2)
screen.drawLine(0,dy, w+1,dy)
screen.drawLine(0,by, w-28,by)
screen.drawText(w - 26,by + 6.5, tonumber(string.format("%.0f", floor)).."m") screen.drawText(w - 26,by + 0.5, "floor")
if sillyMode then
screen.drawText(tx, ty, ":)")
end
screen.setColor(50,25,5,100)
screen.drawText(x1 - 15, y1 + 2.5, tonumber(string.format("%.1f", -depth)).."m") screen.drawText(2, 8, tonumber(string.format("%03.0f", bilt*360)).."'") screen.drawText(2, 2, tonumber(string.format("%.2f", vert)).."m/s") screen.drawText(2, h-7, tonumber(string.format("%.0f", floor + depth)).."m")
end

size = property.getNumber("Size") centerMarkerSize = property.getNumber("Center Marker Size") range = property.getNumber("Range") minDistance = property.getNumber("Min Distance") lifetime = property.getNumber("Dot Lifetime") dotAlpha = property.getNumber("Dot Alpha") rotOffset = property.getNumber("Rotation Offset")-90 connectDistance = property.getNumber("Connect Distance") connectNearby = property.getBool("Connect Nearby") shadow = property.getBool("Radar Shadow") autoRemove = property.getBool("Auto Remove")
lastDotPos = {x=0,y=0}
lidar = false
if property.getNumber("Mode") == 1 then lidar = true end
lidarScanColor = {255, 0, 0,255} radarScanColor = {0, 255, 0,50} playerMarkerColor = {255,0,0,255}
dots = {} dr = 0.0174532925
r = 0 d = 0 t = 0 rad = 6.2831853072
function onTick() d = input.getNumber(1) r = (input.getNumber(2))*rad t = t+1
if d < range and d >= minDistance then local a = true local x=math.floor(((d*size/2/range)*math.cos(r+dr*rotOffset)+size/2)+0.5) local y=math.floor(((d*size/2/range)*math.sin(r+dr*rotOffset)+size/2)+0.5) for k, v in pairs(dots) do if v.x == x and v.y == y then v.t = t a = false break; end end if a == true then dots[#dots+1] = {x=x, y=y, t=t, r=r+dr*rotOffset} end end end
function onDraw() w = screen.getWidth() h = screen.getHeight() if size == 0 then size = h end screen.setColor(0, 0, 0) screen.drawRectF(0,0,size,size); for k, v in pairs(dots) do local l = (lifetime-(t-v.t))/lifetime if l <= 0 then dots[k] = nil elseif autoRemove and (r+dr*rotOffset)-rad > v.r then dots[k] = nil else if not connectNearby then screen.setColor(0, 255, 0, l*dotAlpha) screen.drawRectF(v.x,v.y,1,1) end screen.setColor(0, 255, 0, l*dotAlpha*0.05) if shadow then a = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.cos(v.r)+size/2)+0.5) b = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.sin(v.r)+size/2)+0.5) screen.drawLine(v.x,v.y,a,b)
a = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.cos(v.r+0.1)+size/2)+0.5) b = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.sin(v.r+0.1)+size/2)+0.5) screen.drawLine(v.x,v.y,a,b)
a = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.cos(v.r-0.1)+size/2)+0.5) b = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.sin(v.r-0.1)+size/2)+0.5) screen.drawLine(v.x,v.y,a,b)
a = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.cos(v.r+0.05)+size/2)+0.5) b = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.sin(v.r+0.05)+size/2)+0.5) screen.drawLine(v.x,v.y,a,b)
a = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.cos(v.r-0.05)+size/2)+0.5) b = math.floor(((range*size/2/range)*math.sin(v.r-0.05)+size/2)+0.5) screen.drawLine(v.x,v.y,a,b) end if connectNearby then if math.sqrt((v.x-lastDotPos.x)*(v.x-lastDotPos.x)+(v.y-lastDotPos.y)*(v.y-lastDotPos.y)) < connectDistance then screen.setColor(0, 255, 0, l*dotAlpha) screen.drawLine(v.x,v.y,lastDotPos.x,lastDotPos.y) end lastDotPos = {x=v.x,y=v.y} end end end
local c; local x; local y; if lidar == true then c = lidarScanColor; x = math.floor(((math.min(d, range)*size/2/range)*math.cos(r+dr*rotOffset)+size/2)+0.5) y = math.floor(((math.min(d, range)*size/2/range)*math.sin(r+dr*rotOffset)+size/2)+0.5) else c = radarScanColor x = math.floor(((size/2)*math.cos(r+dr*rotOffset)+size/2)+0.5) y = math.floor(((size/2)*math.sin(r+dr*rotOffset)+size/2)+0.5) end
screen.setColor(c[1],c[2],c[3],c[4]) screen.drawLine(size/2,size/2,x,y) screen.setColor(playerMarkerColor[1],playerMarkerColor[2],playerMarkerColor[3],playerMarkerColor[4]) screen.drawRectF(size/2,size/2,centerMarkerSize,centerMarkerSize) end
